note: Scheduled market events the option candidates must hold through, maintained by the weekly strategist routine. Read by papertrade/candidates.py on every daily run: each future 'fno' event gets an 'Event: <slug> <date> (calendar)' expiry block in the journal's F&O candidates (NIFTY and BANKNIFTY when symbols is empty; a listed stock only if named in symbols and already a candidate); 'us' events are listed at the top of the US candidates with the tabled expiry that covers them. date = the decision / release day (ISO). Past events are ignored; a bad entry is skipped with a warning in the F&O Observations.
